// var(--comment-only) in a comment is not a reference
export function Heat({ region, cat, el }: { region: string; cat: string; el: HTMLElement }) {
  el.style.setProperty('--header-height', '4rem');
  el.style.setProperty(`--cat-${cat}`, 'red');
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        ['--swatch-color' as string]: 'red',
        '--inline-knob': 1,
        color: 'var(--color-text)',
        background: `var(--color-region-${region})`,
        borderColor: `var(--nowhere-${region})`,
        outlineColor: `var(--soft-${region}, currentColor)`,
        top: 'var(--header-height)',
        left: 'var(--knob, 0)',
        right: `var(${region})`,
      }}
      data-css={`--from-text: 2px; margin: var(--from-text)`}
    />
  );
}
